messages.content: Use only the supplied evidence to fulfill the job. Output only JSON {"trail":["code1","code2"],"print_line":"latestCode/seal/footer"}. trail lists the actual print code changes from first to last, no duplicate acknowledgements. print_line is a single label ready to print, literal values separated by slash without spaces. Use UNKNOWN for each unavailable value. Distinguish global footer updates from job-local rules.

Deliver the Alder print label. Evidence:
{"transcript":[{"id":1,"user":"Open the Birch print job. Its print code starts at K14; stamp S58 on this job only.","answer":"The Birch print job is open with its print code starting at K14, and stamp S58 is applied only to this job."},{"id":2,"user":"Open the Alder print job. Start its print code at P83; its seal is S31, only for this job. Set the standing footer on every workspace job to M94.","answer":"The Alder print job is open with its print code starting at P83 and seal S31 applied only to this job, and the workspace-wide standing footer is set to M94."},{"id":3,"user":"For Birch replace the print code with N72. Separately the standing footer on ALL workspace jobs is now M16, superseding the earlier one. Leave the local seal alone.","answer":"Birch’s print code is now N72 with its local seal left unchanged, and the workspace-wide standing footer is now M16, superseding M94."},{"id":4,"user":"On the Alder proof replace its earlier print code with J26. Retain its seal. Confirm the change.","answer":"Confirmed: the Alder proof’s print code is now J26, and its seal S31 is retained."},{"id":5,"user":"For that Birch proof, confirm its current code and seal for the operator.
